name: Do I need a permit for a walk-in shower installation in San Diego or Chula Vista?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a walk-in shower installation in San Diego or Chula Vista?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Replacing a showerhead alone may not require the same approvals as remodeling a tub or shower enclosure, but a tub-to-shower conversion or changes to plumbing, walls, electrical systems, or other building components may require permits. The City of San Diego states that construction, alteration, renovation, or relocation work can require a permit, while limited fixture replacements may be exempt. Requirements can differ by jurisdiction.

Elite Remodeling & Design can include permit coordination in a broader remodeling plan, but the applicable city or county authority determines requirements.

Key factors:
- Whether plumbing fixtures move
- Wall, framing, or electrical changes
- City jurisdiction and property type
- Whether plans or inspections are required

Before work starts, confirm the permit path and who submits applications. Include permits and inspection milestones in the written scope.

Handling approvals early can prevent avoidable start or closeout delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Possibly. A tub-to-shower conversion may involve plumbing, wall, electrical, or enclosure changes that require approval, while limited fixture replacements may be treated differently. Confirm requirements with the applicable city before work begins and state who will coordinate applications and inspections.
